_comment: Source of truth for the parity table in README.md and STATUS.md. Regenerate with: python parity/parity_table.py

rows.name: proxy surface
rows.notes: /v1/chat/completions, /v1/models, /health, bearer-key check, Flask jsonify byte format, werkzeug 404/415 pages

rows.name: approach selection
rows.notes: slug prefix, optillm_approach in body, <optillm_approach> tags, & pipeline, | parallel, n repeats, untagging of User:/Assistant: output

rows.name: none (passthrough)
rows.notes: openai-python model_dump shape, create() kwarg TypeError, 2 retries on 5xx/429, SSE re-chunking incl. tool calls and usage

rows.name: batching
rows.notes: --batch-mode/--batch-size/--batch-wait-ms; per model:approach queues, sequential processing, wrapped error messages

rows.name: conversation logging
rows.notes: --log-conversations JSONL ported; not compared by the harness (timestamps, uuids)

rows.name: provider selection
rows.notes: OPENAI_API_KEY, CEREBRAS_API_KEY, AZURE_OPENAI_API_KEY supported. OPTILLM_API_KEY (upstream: in-process PyTorch engine) is emulated on the configured provider (see decoder rows). Gaps: LiteLLM fallback not ported; Azure AD (DefaultAzureCredential) auth not supported; --launch-gui (Gradio) not supported

rows.name: self_consistency
rows.notes: difflib.SequenceMatcher ported incl. autojunk

rows.name: mcts
rows.notes: seeded: CPython MT19937 random.choice; numpy log/sqrt replaced by f64 (only affects exact UCB ties)

rows.name: pvg
rows.notes: upstream module-global token counter (never reset, grows across requests) replicated

rows.name: rstar
rows.notes: concurrent asyncio rollouts reproduced; harness serialises mock replies so seeded draws line up

rows.name: leap
rows.notes: Python json/iteration error semantics for malformed example JSON

rows.name: mars
rows.notes: port of optillm/mars (not crates/mars). Shared executor = FIFO semaphore; str-vs-int agent-id quirk kept (agent 0 verifies all, improvement never runs); math_verify fails in upstream's server threads (signal-based timeout) so voting uses the regex fallback natively; agg_HHMMSS ids normalised by the harness; CPython 3.12 Neumaier sum() ported

rows.name: cepo
rows.notes: nested thread pools + as_completed reproduced; process-global mutable config; --cepo_bestofn_rating_type / --cepo_rating_model accepted as str (upstream argparse rejects them, use --cepo_config_file); majority vote uses the MCQ path only (math_verify is unreachable with non-empty completions)

rows.name: z3
rows.notes: solver code runs in CPython+z3+sympy subprocess ($OPTILLM_Z3_PYTHON) with upstream exec globals; harness normalises the exec frame path in tracebacks

rows.name: cot_decoding
rows.notes: Remote provider: identical TypeError for decoding=, slug not an approach. OPTILLM_API_KEY mode: same algorithm over logprobs + assistant prefill (k capped at 20 top logprobs; num_beams/length_penalty/no_repeat_ngram_size unavailable)

rows.name: entropy_decoding
rows.notes: Remote: parity. Local mode: logits-only approximation (1 call/token, top-20 logprobs, attention metrics = 0, no clarification-token insertion)

rows.name: thinkdeeper
rows.notes: Remote: parity. Local mode: same control loop, chunked with stop=[end_think_token]; max_thoughts checked between chunks

rows.name: deepconf
rows.notes: Remote: parity. Local mode: warmup/threshold/consensus/weighted vote over top-k logprobs; early termination applied post hoc

rows.name: autothink
rows.notes: Remote: parity. Local mode: NOT available (needs in-process complexity classifier + steering vectors on hidden states)

rows.name: compact
rows.notes: tiktoken cl100k_base via tiktoken-rs; models.retrieve() context-length probe reproduced

rows.name: deepthink
rows.notes: SELF-DISCOVER 39 modules + 4 JSON-recovery strategies + uncertainty routing (difflib, Neumaier sum)
